# RC33 — changed-file diff picker

Date: 2026-07-28

## Scope

- Added `Esc v D` / `:diffs` as a searchable changed-path diff picker.
- The picker snapshots the current Git status, filters by path/status text, and opens the selected path's staged and working-tree diff as a read-only IDE view.
- Existing active-file diff behavior remains at `Esc v d` / `:diff`.
- Git state is not mutated by the new picker. It does not stage, unstage, save, discard, switch, pull, push, or commit.

## Proof boundary

This is host-side automated and package evidence only. It does not prove real iPad Magic Keyboard key delivery, Blink/mosh/tmux routing, OSC 52 clipboard behavior, touch/trackpad feel, reconnect behavior, or a real language server. Run `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md` on the target hardware route before treating this as hardware-approved.
